title: scleria rugosa var. onoei
intro: Scleria rugosa var. onoei, commonly known as Onoe's sedge, is a plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in Asian medicine, particularly in Japan, to treat various health conditions due to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits. The health benefits of Onoe's sedge include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Onoe's sedge include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antihistaminic, and anti-inflammatory activities.
